title: Jubilant Smoky Norwegian Potatoes Roast
description: A hearty Norwegian dish featuring smoky, fluffy potatoes, perfect for a crowd, this ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly recipe is sure to please. It combines the richness of potatoes with the depth of smoky flavors.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper for easy cleanup.
In a large bowl, toss the potatoes with olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic, salt, black pepper, and caraway seeds until they are evenly coated.
Spread the potatoes out in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet.
Roast the potatoes in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.
Remove the potatoes from the oven and toss them to redistribute.
Return the potatoes to the oven and continue roasting for an additional 20 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly browned.
Remove the potatoes from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
Serve the smoky Norwegian potatoes hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
